title: Abstract Class with Interface
instructions:
Complete the code so that `RobotArm` extends the abstract class `Mechanism` and implements the `Controllable` interface.

`RobotArm` should:
1. Pass "Arm" as the name to `Mechanism`
2. Override `performAction()` to print "Arm moving to position"
3. Implement `enable()` to set `isEnabled` to `true`
4. Implement `disable()` to set `isEnabled` to `false`
hint: Use `: Mechanism("Arm"), Controllable` to extend the abstract class and implement the interface at the same time. Then override all three methods.
